attributes.title: [Logs OpenFSSO] Clients
attributes.description: Delivery failures, selected users and versions of the OpenFSSO clients.

query.esql:
FROM logs-openfsso.client-*
| STATS clients = COUNT_DISTINCT(host.name)

FROM logs-openfsso.client-*
| STATS clients = COUNT_DISTINCT(host.name)

FROM logs-openfsso.client-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("delivery-failed", "logon-unavailable", "receiver-recovered", "client-ready")
| INLINE STATS started = MAX(CASE(event.action == "client-ready", @timestamp, NULL)) BY host.name
| WHERE event.action != "client-ready" AND (started IS NULL OR @timestamp > started)
| STATS latest = MAX(CONCAT(TO_STRING(@timestamp), " ", event.action)) BY host.name, server.address
| WHERE NOT ENDS_WITH(latest, " receiver-recovered")
| STATS failing = COUNT_DISTINCT(host.name)

FROM logs-openfsso.client-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("delivery-failed", "logon-unavailable", "receiver-recovered", "client-ready")
| INLINE STATS started = MAX(CASE(event.action == "client-ready", @timestamp, NULL)) BY host.name
| WHERE event.action != "client-ready" AND (started IS NULL OR @timestamp > started)
| STATS latest = MAX(CONCAT(TO_STRING(@timestamp), " ", event.action)) BY host.name, server.address
| WHERE NOT ENDS_WITH(latest, " receiver-recovered")
| STATS failing = COUNT_DISTINCT(host.name)

FROM logs-openfsso.client-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("delivery-failed", "logon-unavailable")
| STATS failures = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openfsso.client-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("delivery-failed", "logon-unavailable")
| STATS failures = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openfsso.client-*
| WHERE event.action == "owner-selected"
| STATS users = COUNT_DISTINCT(user.name)

FROM logs-openfsso.client-*
| WHERE event.action == "owner-selected"
| STATS users = COUNT_DISTINCT(user.name)

FROM logs-openfsso.client-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("delivery-failed", "logon-unavailable")
| STATS failures = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 48, ?_tstart, ?_tend), server.address
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-openfsso.client-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("delivery-failed", "logon-unavailable")
| STATS failures = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 48, ?_tstart, ?_tend), server.address
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-openfsso.client-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("delivery-failed", "logon-unavailable")
| EVAL cause = CASE(http.response.status_code IS NOT NULL, CONCAT("HTTP ", TO_STRING(http.response.status_code)), event.action == "logon-unavailable", "Logon unavailable", error.type)
| STATS failures = COUNT(*) BY cause
| SORT failures DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-openfsso.client-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("delivery-failed", "logon-unavailable")
| EVAL cause = CASE(http.response.status_code IS NOT NULL, CONCAT("HTTP ", TO_STRING(http.response.status_code)), event.action == "logon-unavailable", "Logon unavailable", error.type)
| STATS failures = COUNT(*) BY cause
| SORT failures DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-openfsso.client-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("delivery-failed", "logon-unavailable", "receiver-recovered", "client-ready")
| INLINE STATS started = MAX(CASE(event.action == "client-ready", @timestamp, NULL)) BY host.name
| WHERE event.action != "client-ready" AND (started IS NULL OR @timestamp > started)
| EVAL state = CONCAT(TO_STRING(@timestamp), "|", event.action, "|", COALESCE(error.type, ""), "|", COALESCE(TO_STRING(http.response.status_code), ""))
| STATS latest = MAX(state) BY host.name, server.address
| EVAL parts = SPLIT(latest, "|")
| EVAL since = TO_DATETIME(MV_FIRST(parts)), failure = MV_SLICE(parts, 1, 1), error = MV_SLICE(parts, 2, 2), http_status = MV_SLICE(parts, 3, 3)
| WHERE failure != "receiver-recovered"
| KEEP host.name, server.address, since, failure, error, http_status
| SORT since DESC
| LIMIT 200

FROM logs-openfsso.client-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("delivery-failed", "logon-unavailable", "receiver-recovered", "client-ready")
| INLINE STATS started = MAX(CASE(event.action == "client-ready", @timestamp, NULL)) BY host.name
| WHERE event.action != "client-ready" AND (started IS NULL OR @timestamp > started)
| EVAL state = CONCAT(TO_STRING(@timestamp), "|", event.action, "|", COALESCE(error.type, ""), "|", COALESCE(TO_STRING(http.response.status_code), ""))
| STATS latest = MAX(state) BY host.name, server.address
| EVAL parts = SPLIT(latest, "|")
| EVAL since = TO_DATETIME(MV_FIRST(parts)), failure = MV_SLICE(parts, 1, 1), error = MV_SLICE(parts, 2, 2), http_status = MV_SLICE(parts, 3, 3)
| WHERE failure != "receiver-recovered"
| KEEP host.name, server.address, since, failure, error, http_status
| SORT since DESC
| LIMIT 200

FROM logs-openfsso.client-*
| WHERE service.version IS NOT NULL
| STATS latest = MAX(CONCAT(TO_STRING(@timestamp), " ", service.version)) BY host.name
| EVAL version = MV_LAST(SPLIT(latest, " "))
| STATS clients = COUNT(*) BY version
| SORT clients DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-openfsso.client-*
| WHERE service.version IS NOT NULL
| STATS latest = MAX(CONCAT(TO_STRING(@timestamp), " ", service.version)) BY host.name
| EVAL version = MV_LAST(SPLIT(latest, " "))
| STATS clients = COUNT(*) BY version
| SORT clients DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-openfsso.client-*
| WHERE event.action == "fabric-status-changed"
| STATS latest = MAX(CONCAT(TO_STRING(@timestamp), " ", openfsso.fabric_state)) BY host.name
| EVAL state = MV_LAST(SPLIT(latest, " "))
| STATS clients = COUNT(*) BY state
| SORT clients DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-openfsso.client-*
| WHERE event.action == "fabric-status-changed"
| STATS latest = MAX(CONCAT(TO_STRING(@timestamp), " ", openfsso.fabric_state)) BY host.name
| EVAL state = MV_LAST(SPLIT(latest, " "))
| STATS clients = COUNT(*) BY state
| SORT clients DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-openfsso.client-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("owner-selected", "owner-logged-off")
| STATS events = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 24, ?_tstart, ?_tend), event.action
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-openfsso.client-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("owner-selected", "owner-logged-off")
| STATS events = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 24, ?_tstart, ?_tend), event.action
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-openfsso.client-*
| WHERE log.level IN ("Warning", "Error", "Fatal")
| KEEP @timestamp, host.name, log.level, event.action, server.address, user.name, error.type, http.response.status_code, error.message
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 200

FROM logs-openfsso.client-*
| WHERE log.level IN ("Warning", "Error", "Fatal")
| KEEP @timestamp, host.name, log.level, event.action, server.address, user.name, error.type, http.response.status_code, error.message
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 200

FROM logs-openfsso.client-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("owner-selected", "owner-logged-off", "waiting-for-logon")
| KEEP @timestamp, host.name, event.action, user.domain, user.name, openfsso.session_id
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 500

FROM logs-openfsso.client-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("owner-selected", "owner-logged-off", "waiting-for-logon")
| KEEP @timestamp, host.name, event.action, user.domain, user.name, openfsso.session_id
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 500
